fusions.name: Taut Tether
fusions.desc: Stretches a line 5 tiles long across the ground ahead of you for 6 seconds. It deals 12 damage to each enemy that crosses it, stuns it for 1.2 seconds and slows it by 30% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Anchor Line
fusions.desc: Casts a weighted line that deals 4 damage and leaps to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 50% of that. Each hit has a 25% chance of [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Hauled to the Deep
fusions.desc: Throws a line 5 tiles long ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward. Anything it catches moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: No Slack
fusions.desc: Your damage rises by 12% against enemies carrying your afflictions.
